title: Compare a paid local receipt policy with fixed pioneer allocation
statement: With correct acceptancea=p*beta^h and false acceptanceb=(1-p)*alpha^h per disposable attempt, obtainingK distinct correct receipts withinN attempts succeeds withPr[Bin(N,a+b)>=K]*(a/(a+b))^K under the declared independent reader law.

body: The source must know which distinct role to attempt next and cannot silently rescue a false receipt. Count failed attempts, allh readings, discarded structures and the budget. A shared systematic all-positive state defeats repeated reading. A synthetic feedback cost crossover is conditional on an actual reader/structure cost ratio, not a demonstrated sensor or biological advantage.
